name: USS Hornet Museum Volunteer (ages 16 and up)
org: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum
what_you_do: Restore aircraft or the ship, work in the radio room, do outreach, or help visitors. Teens 16 and 17 work with an adult.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up for aircraft restoration, ship restoration, radio, community outreach and visitor services (16 and 17 year olds work with an adult). Collections: 18 and up. Docents, events, security: 21 and up.
duration: Set weekly shifts, for example Wed and Sat 8:30 to noon (aircraft), Tue and Sat (ship), first Saturday monthly (radio)
how_to_apply: Apply at volgistics.com/appform/1737643431 or call (510) 521-8448 ext. 243.
notes: Ship work involves climbing ladders and tight spaces. Another museum page lists overnight programs for groups, but no teen intern program.
